AI's growing role in workforce management draws attention

The increasing integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into the workforce is prompting discussions about its impact on workers. In Singapore, companies are expanding their use of AI, leading to more workers managing AI-powered bots. Concurrently, in the United States, attention is being drawn to the pressures faced by American workers' wages, with AI's potential role in this dynamic being a subject of growing interest. These developments highlight a global trend of AI adoption and its implications for labor.
